mission: Implement consequential remaining functionality from the comprehensive plan and Beads, with meaningful direct-main GitHub commits and no PRs.

basis.selection: The plan, backlog and actual implementation were inspected before edits. Many broad open items already had implementations; selected concrete unsupported input profiles in the working media/model paths.

requirements.state: open; finite transport and retained-import capability advanced
open; additional native model layers admitted

authority.repository: User explicitly authorized direct commits to main through GitHub. Publications use verified parent trees and expected-head checks with force=false.
authority.runtime: Existing bounded source-read, cancellation, publication and inference owners remain authoritative. No live camera or external provider was contacted.
authority.concurrent_work: Concurrent website, native archive, recovery and HEVC changes were preserved. This session does not claim those changes as its deliverables.

delivered.feature: Explicit M2TS parser and extraction receipts
delivered.scope: 192-byte framing with opaque four-byte prefixes; absolute original-source spans, complete original digests, inner-TS continuity and versioned receipts. Existing 188-byte entry points and receipt bytes retain their meaning.

delivered.feature: One-dimensional Conv, MaxPool and AveragePool import
delivered.scope: Static F32 NCW source tensors lower through existing spatial kernels and exact reshapes. Grouping, runtime weights, supported padding and finite resource/cancellation rules remain enforced. No operator, dependency or durable format added.

delivered.feature: Native retained M2TS import and operator command
delivered.scope: Explicit --ts-framing ts188|m2ts192; v2 M2TS requests agree with extraction framing; retained original custody/replay and reports carry the selection. Existing default request identity is unchanged.
delivered.validation: Source-reviewed and formatting-parsed; native compilation/execution blocked before these targets.

media.scope: Actual pinned Cargo library suite, including every new M2TS framing/receipt case and legacy byte vectors.

legacy_compatibility.method: Compile and run the entire unmodified baseline MPEG-TS parser and receipt encoder, comparing with the current production implementation.
legacy_compatibility.result: AVC and HEVC v1 receipts are byte-for-byte identical, 299 bytes each; fixed hex vectors are checked by the passing Cargo suite.

model.scope: Real production scalar/optimized source and actual canonical graph/Safetensors reload. Same original full Cargo-built harness; no alternative host, stand-ins, removed assertions or dependency substitutions.
model.initial_build: Production core/tensor/model-IR libraries compiled; ordinary test-executable code generation was terminated by SIGKILL 9.
model.execution: Run the exact emitted executable with --test-threads=1; focused eight cases then the unfiltered original harness.

native_attempts.settings: Pinned compiler; locked/offline; one Cargo job; debug/incremental disabled; documented serial frontend/backend/linker, MIR0/fewer-names flags; Asupersync and fss-reference codegen256 dev/test profiles.

first.result: Shared-filesystem ENOSPC while crossbeam-queue attempted to create a metadata directory, before changed source.

retry.result: After removing only reproducible installer staging/archive copies, unchanged Asupersync 0.5.0 metadata compilation was terminated by SIGKILL 9. No source diagnostic; reference importer and CLI were not reached.
retry.cause: SIGKILL is confirmed; its underlying cause was not independently established.

native_attempts.boundary: No native importer/CLI compile or runtime pass is claimed. No heavier repeat or duplicate CLI check through the same killed dependency was attempted.

validation.formatting: All five model source/test files pass pinned rustfmt. All eight native/CLI files parse with pinned rustfmt; five are fully clean, three retain only pre-existing formatting outside changed sections.
validation.source_review: Root and an independent model agent reviewed all eight native/CLI files for framing identity, request/receipt mismatch, original custody, bounded replay, authority and API consistency; no blocker found.
validation.integrity: Each meaningful publication carries touched layered-manifest rows; staged coverage/whitespace checks and exact published blob checks are used. No full-workspace, Clippy, live-device or release qualification is claimed.

limits: M2TS prefixes remain opaque; they do not establish capture time, clock synchronization, continuity or absence evidence.
The existing bounded AVC/HEVC finite-file subset and 64 MiB original/elementary native ceilings remain.
One-dimensional internal model layers do not add an audio input or change the RGB package's explicit image/head contract.
Runtime reshapes use existing accounted copy kernels; this is not a zero-copy or acceleration claim.
Native retained-import/CLI tests remain unexecuted until the genuine dependency graph completes on a suitable host.
Broad model/media Beads and repository-owned qualification/DSR requirements remain open.
